channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Team USA's Connor Hellebuyck To Receive Presidential Medal Of Freedom, Trump Says
item.description: U.S. president Donald Trump said goaltender Connor Hellebuyck will soon be presented with the highest civilian honor and praised him for his 41-save gold medal game performance.

item.title: Politics Aside, Auston Matthews Probably Should Not Have Visited The White House
item.description: Blame the NHL scheduler-makers for putting so many U.S. Olympians in a spot where they had to choose between team and country.

item.title: Penguins Expected To Face Strong NHL Opponents Without Sidney Crosby
item.description: The Pittsburgh Penguins are expected to play seven games against division leaders over the next four weeks without captain Sidney Crosby, who was injured at the Olympics.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Will Nazem Kadri, Elias Pettersson And Steven Stamkos Get Moved By The Trade Deadline?
item.description: It appears only a matter of time until the Calgary Flames trade Nazem Kadri; there is growing trade interest in Vancouver Canucks center Elias Pettersson, and Nashville Predators forward Steven Stamkos reminds everyone why he's not sweating the upcoming trade deadline.

item.title: Projecting Team USA's 2030 Olympic Men's Hockey Roster
item.description: Did any of Team USA gold medallists play in their last Olympics? Who could be ready to grab a spot in 2030? Here is its way-too-early projected American men's hockey roster for the 2030 Olympic Games.

item.title: Capitals Place Sonny Milano On NHL Waivers
item.description: Washington Capitals left winger Sonny Milano hasn't played an AHL game since the 2022-23 season, but he's on NHL waivers.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: What Changes Would You Make To The World Cup Of Hockey?
item.description: Drew Shore, Michael Traikos and Andrew McInnis discuss the return to NHL action, expectations for players returning from the Olympics, the 2028 World Cup of Hockey and more.

item.title: Who Offers Best Bet To Win NHL's Art Ross Trophy?
item.description: Superstars on the Edmonton Oilers, Colorado Avalanche and Tampa Bay Lightning are the favorites of winning the Art Ross Trophy, but what are the odds of each of them getting the title? Gary Pearson examines for BetMGM.

item.title: Team USA's Women's And Men's Players Address Backlash About Trump Call
item.description: Boston Bruins netminder Jeremy Swayman said the U.S. men's team should have reacted differently to U.S. president Donald Trump's comments regarding the women's squad. Players on the women's squad, meanwhile, discussed the support they received from the men's team in Italy.

item.title: The NHL's Playoff Race Is About To Get Incredibly Fierce
item.description: The NHL is back in action Wednesday night. And in the Eastern and Western Conferences, the battle for a wild-card position will be fierce. Here's what that means for the next week and beyond.
